blocks.text: A network decoy group allows you to logically organize networks and threat intelligence decoys based on function, location, system type, etc. A decoy group categorizes the detected alerts along logical boundaries. You can create a network decoy group based on:

blocks.item: Business functions, such as HR, Legal, IT, Accounts, etc.
Geographic regions, such as USA, APAC, EU, etc.
System types, such as desktops, laptops, servers, etc.

blocks.text: You can create a network group from the Deceive Settings page or when creating a network decoy.
To create a network decoy group:

blocks.item: Go to Deceive > Deceive Settings > Network Decoy Groups.
In the Network Decoy Group Details window, enter a name for the group and click Submit.

blocks.text: The network decoy group is added to the Network Decoys Group table.
Under Actions, click the Edit icon to edit the network decoy group or the Delete icon to delete the network decoy group.
